segments.ja419:1.3: Sabbaṃ harassu bhaddante, mañca dāsīti sāvaya.
segments.ja419:2.1: Oropayassu kalyāṇi, mā bāḷhaṃ [bahuṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] paridevasi;
segments.ja419:3.1: Yato sarāmi attānaṃ, yato pattāsmi viññutaṃ;
segments.ja419:3.3: Na cāhaṃ abhijānāmi, aññaṃ piyataraṃ tayā.
segments.ja419:4.3: Na hi dāni puna atthi, mama tuyhañca saṅgamo.
segments.ja419:5.1: Na hi sabbesu ṭhānesu, puriso hoti paṇḍito;
segments.ja419:5.3: Itthīpi paṇḍitā hoti, tattha tattha vicakkhaṇā.
segments.ja419:6.1: Na hi sabbesu ṭhānesu, puriso hoti paṇḍito;
segments.ja419:6.3: Itthīpi paṇḍitā hoti, lahuṃ atthaṃ vicintikā [lahumatthavicintikā (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja419:9.1: Yo ca uppatitaṃ atthaṃ, khippameva nibodhati;
